questions.question: By what does David ask God to save him?
options: By the wealth of his treasury
By the strength of his army
By the wisdom of his counselors

questions.question: What is the occasion of Psalm 54?
options: When the Ziphites told Saul David was hiding among them
When Absalom rose up and drove David out from Jerusalem
When David fled for refuge to the cave of Adullam
When the Philistines seized hold of David in the city of Gath
questions.answer: When the Ziphites told Saul David was hiding among them

questions.question: David says God is his helper and the upholder of his life.
I will give thanks to your name, O LORD, for it is _____.
